comment: Built from content/traversal.json by tools/content/contentc.mjs (npm run content): edit there, not here. How you get around an open world on foot, in water and in the air. Read by src/content/traversal.ts. Slopes are rise over run (1.0 = 45 degrees). Speeds m/s, heights m, times in sim frames unless named Seconds. ground.stepUp is how high a ledge or a box top you walk straight up onto; decks (piers, the glider launch) are built to be walked onto, so deckStep is theirs (the launch deck stands 0.6 above its plateau). A deck you can neither step onto nor pass under is solid from the side; one at least deckHeadroom above your feet has room to walk or swim under (a pier over the water). storm: in rain, water deeper than fromDepth gets rough (full at fullDepth); hullDamage is [boat length up to, hit points a second at full storm]; a boat that breaks up is back after repairSeconds.
